newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber closes mixed on weak demand.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber closes mixed on weak demand.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were quoted mixed at the close after a quiet trading session due to a lack of consumer demand, traders said.
"There was no sales recorded for the day and we don't expect much changes in the near term," said a trader.
Dealers said despite the lack of demand, the current low production period, due to winter, was likely to limit the market's downside.
At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted March RSS1 buyer at 304 cents ($1.23) a kg, unchanged from Tuesday.
March SMR 20 was 1.50 cents lower at 296.50.
Traders offered drum latex at 238 cents a kg, SMR CV at 360 SMR L at 340, SMR 5 at 306, SMR 10 at 296 and SMR 20 at 295.
The INRO five-day average was 232.19 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on March 4 from 231.84 on March 3. The daily indicator was at 232.75 against 232.94.
